name: Speedy Squirrel
description: A Shopify app, also called ShipMagic, that calculates checkout shipping rates from weight, zones, product tags, and other rules, and connects a store to carriers such as USPS, FedEx, and Australia Post. Founder Aditya Malani, Bangalore.

mentions.evidence: Self-reported, Starter Story, 13 December 2024. Not independently checked. About $11,000 a month. The same page references a 2025 podcast with the founder at $12,000 a month. Both figures stay. I am not treating the podcast line as a newer check.
mentions.indieAngle: One painful Shopify setting, and the app-store search term for it.

whyItPrints: Shipping rules are tedious, and once they are set nobody wants to touch them. It is an install-and-leave subscription. The page says ranking in the top five for "Shipping Calculator" in the Shopify App Store brings more than 15 installs a day. Starting cost was about $200.
whyThisMatters:
Speedy Squirrel, also called ShipMagic, is a Shopify app. At checkout it prices the shipping from weight, zones, product tags, and a long list of other rules, then talks to carriers such as USPS, FedEx, and Australia Post. Aditya Malani, in Bangalore, runs it.

The December 2024 article says about eleven thousand a month. The same page points at a 2025 podcast where he said twelve thousand a month. I am not replacing one with the other, and I am not calling the podcast a fresh check. Starting out cost about two hundred. He says a top-five place in the Shopify App Store for "Shipping Calculator" brings more than fifteen installs a day.

You pay so the rate at checkout is a rule, not a guess the merchant retypes. Once it works, nobody opens it.
